name: astra-forge
description: Project AstraForge - Tony Stark style holographic design space bridging 2D images, AI generation, and physical fabrication

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @astraforge/server" "npm run dev -w @astraforge/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @astraforge/shared && npm run build -w @astraforge/server && npm run build -w @astraforge/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @astraforge/shared && npm run typecheck -w @astraforge/server && npm run typecheck -w @astraforge/web
scripts.vision:setup: cd services/vision && python -m venv .venv && .venv/Scripts/pip install -r requirements.txt
